_comment: Per-fixture expectations for the round-trip gate (test/roundtrip.test.js).
Any corpus file NOT listed here must be editable and must round-trip byte-identically.
A file listed with identity:'fail' is a KNOWN defect. The gate asserts it still fails,
so fixing the parser forces an update here — that is the point. When a fix lands,
delete the entry and the file becomes a permanent regression test.
severity:'corruption' means the emitted file is not equivalent to the input —
it changes meaning or is invalid Astro. Those are bugs, not formatting drift.
severity:'formatting' means the output is semantically the same file, reformatted.

note: serializeNode re-indents the whole tree at two spaces per level, so a project
using four-space indentation has every page reformatted on first save.
A paragraph of text with an expression in it — `© {`${year} ${SITE_NAME}`}.
All rights reserved.` — is written back on three lines, one per node.
isInlineRun (astroParser.js) counts elements as inline but not expr nodes, so a
run holding one is not recognised as a run and each child gets its own line.
Renders the same (the breaks collapse to spaces); the diff is the problem.

Same cause as copyright-as-authored, in a page-sized file: `

We’re
{SITE_NAME}, and we’ve shipped {stats.length} things

since …

` becomes one line per node. Kept as a fixture because it also
exercises entities, a map loop, a component, a style block and a script in the
same file.
The hanging-bracket style — `<a href={href}` / `\t\t>Join our Discord <svg …` —
is reflowed: tabs become the serializer's two-space indent and each tag gets its
own line. The text's own boundary space survives the reflow now (that was the
double-save bug); what is left is the indentation style, which the serializer
does not preserve.
A blank line before the `---` fence. The compiler, and a real `astro build` (checked
on Astro 5.14), read that block as frontmatter, so Stacki does too (astroFence.ts, the
one fence reader). Before, the block was taken for body text. The serializer still
drops the blank line and re-indents the four-space markup: formatting only, an edit
is a splice and leaves them alone.
